:::{#def-random-variable}
#### Random variable

A **random variable** is a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/functional-programming.html#def-function)
from a [sample space](probability-basics.qmd#def-sample-space) $\samplespace$
to the real numbers $\reals$
[@wikipedia_random_variable]:
it assigns a number to each possible outcome of a [random experiment](probability-basics.qmd#def-random-experiment).

:::
